product_metadata.title: SUPPORT PLUS Cervical Neck Pillow - Neck Pain Relief Bolster Pillow, Lumbar Support Pillow, Knee Pillow, Foam Long Pillow for Side and Back Sleepers with Removable, Breathable Mesh Cover
features: ENHANCE YOUR SLEEPING COMFORT - Perfect for side and back sleepers, this handy Cervical Foam Roll Pillow can alleviate neck and back pain by supporting proper upper spine curve and alignment, improving sleeping posture.

GIVE YOUR REGULAR PILLOW A BOOST - Slip this soft, lightweight yet sturdy roll cushion into your pillowcase to create an ergonomic area on top of your standard soft pillow that targets your neck area, comfortably cradling it as you slumber.

ELEVATE YOUR LEGS - Help to relieve back, leg, knee, and hip pain by placing this sturdy bolster under your knees to raise your legs while sleeping on your back. Or encourage improved circulation by positioning it under your ankles to lift your feet, and assist with post-surgery recovery.

EASE TENSION AT THE OFFICE - Prop this perfectly-sized foam log between your back and the back of your chair to help you sit up straighter, improve sitting posture and reduce lumbar strain as you work. It also makes a great yoga or massage accessory.

SOFT, REMOVABLE COVER INCLUDED - Easy zip-close white cover is made of breathable, machine washable, 100% polyester mesh. Filling is 100% polyurethane foam. Pillow measures 17 1/2" long x 3 1/2" in diameter.
